notes: Catalog seeded from emea-tes-team identity search.
Entitlement names are related to roles but never identical, except Workplace User.
Title role membership uses CONTAINS on attribute.titleHistory with bracketed tokens (e.g. [Accounts Payable Analyst]).
sodViolationRoles are requestable roles that deliberately bundle both sides of an SoD policy for demo violations.
Live SuccessFactors departments and live SuccessFactors or NERM-only titles added for active identities. NERM locations and departments already matched the workplace cities and department roles.

sodViolationRoles.name: SoD Demo — Payment Release and Bank Portal

sodViolationRoles.name: SoD Demo — Payroll Run and Compensation Bands
sodViolationRoles.description: Contains a policy violation of SOD-HR-01 (Payroll Run Desk vs Comp Band Desk). Requestable demo role; do not use in production.

sodViolationRoles.name: SoD Demo — Domain Admin and Audit Workpapers
sodViolationRoles.description: Contains a policy violation of SOD-SEC-01 (Domain Ops Console vs Audit Workpaper Desk). Requestable demo role; do not use in production.

sodViolationRoles.name: SoD Demo — Production Hotfix and QA Signoff
sodViolationRoles.description: Contains a policy violation of SOD-ENG-01 (Hotfix Desk vs Release Signoff Desk). Requestable demo role; do not use in production.

sodViolationRoles.name: SoD Demo — Requisition and Contract Desks
sodViolationRoles.description: Contains a policy violation of SOD-SCM-01 (Purchase Requisition Desk vs Contract Desk). Requestable demo role; do not use in production.
